WHAT IT DOES: one anchored programmatic patch adding, immediately after the existing daily stamp inside hr_farm_plant, the lifetime twin in hr_farm_harvest shape VERBATIM - same column list, same conflict target (user_id, slot, kind, key, period_key), same additive DO UPDATE, state=active, period_key=empty. Four executable lines; nothing else in the body moves.
